translations.web: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
translations.bsb: So the master told his servant, ‘Go out to the highways and hedges and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.
translations.kjv: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
translations.asv: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and constrain them to come in, that my house may be filled.
